Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing lodging taxes to be used to fund law enforcement officers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to allowing lodging taxes to be used to fund lawenforcement officers; and amending RCW 67.28.1815.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 67.28.1815 and 2008 c 264 s 3 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Except as provided in RCW 67.28.180, all revenue from taxes imposedunder this chapter shall be credited to a special fund in the treasuryof the municipality imposing such tax and used solely for: (1) The purpose of paying all or any part of the cost of tourismpromotion, acquisition of tourismrelated facilities, or operation oftourismrelated facilities. Municipalities may, under chapter 39.34RCW, agree to the utilization of revenue from taxes imposed under thischapter for the purposes of funding a multijurisdictional tourismrelated facility; or (2) The purpose of funding additional law enforcement officers forthe municipality, but may not be used to supplant existing funding forlaw enforcement officers.
